# The stand arrow's sounds: where they come from

The stand arrow's sounds (2.71.0, `src/main/resources/assets/celestialfall/sounds/stand_arrow_*.ogg`) are cut from
these recordings by `tools/stand/cut_arrow_sounds.py` (stretches of them, mono, faded at the cuts, set to a loudness;
the glow's played backwards; nothing synthesized). 2.71.1 took out every voice (the sighs, breaths, gasps and the
choke, with their recordings) and made the blow anew from other recordings (the magic blow and the glow). Every one is dedicated to the public domain under **CC0 1.0 Universal**
(https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/): no attribution is required; it is given here anyway.
